#define LZ4_COPYSTEP(s, d)	\ /* <=== lib/lz4/lz4defs.h:119:124:LZ4_COPYSTEP:2 */ 
	do {			\
		PUT4(s, d);	\
		d += 4;		\
		s += 4;		\
	} while (0)

#define LZ4_WILDCOPY(s, d, e)		\ /* <=== lib/lz4/lz4defs.h:146:149:LZ4_WILDCOPY:3 */ 
	do {				\
		LZ4_COPYPACKET(s, d);	\
	} while (d < e)

#define PUT4(s, d) \ /* <=== lib/lz4/lz4defs.h:49:50:PUT4:2 */ 
	put_unaligned(get_unaligned((const u32 *) s), (u32 *) d)
